text:
Maya: handing off — quick oncall summary. I'm off at 08:00 PST, leaving monitoring for the next 2h.

Maya: Current incident: model-autoscaler churn in dedicated-gpu-east. Observed frequent restarts of model-server pods (v2-quant) and a bump in 5xxs (~12% over baseline) over the last 30m.

Maya: What I did: scaled down the canary pool (2 -> 0), pinned canary to v2-quant-stable, restarted the autoscaler controller, and disabled the aggressive-burst autoscaling policy.

Maya: Mitigations applied: pinned variant, set podOOMScoreAdj to -999 for model-server pods, and temporarily disabled batching heuristics for canary via route override.

Maya: Blockers: can't reproduce locally; need GPU kernel logs and container OOM traces from worker-gpu-12 to confirm root cause.

Maya: Next steps: Alex to fetch GPU/kernel logs and previous container logs; Ron to watch metrics and health checks for 1h; if churn continues we revert traffic to v1-serve.

Alex: on it — pulling logs now. Running:
```
kubectl logs model-server-abc -n inference --previous | grep -i oom
ssh gpu-admin@worker-gpu-12 'dmesg | tail -n 200'
```

Alex: quick find — saw "Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (python)" in dmesg around 07:42 PST, and the container exited with OOMKilled. Posting full logs to gist.

Ron: I'll own the watch. Memory graphs show a spike coincident with a larger batch at 07:42; looks like a sudden batch size + input size combo pushed it over. Could be a regression in batching config.

Sam: proposed quick workaround: lower max_batch_size to 8 for this model via route config and restart replicas. Low risk and should reduce peak mem. Can roll in 10m if agreed.

Jess: customer impact? which routes are affected and do we need a page?

Maya: no active customer pages yet — only canary and ~10% hosted traffic hitting canary. If errors reach prod thresholds we'll open an incident.

IncidentBot: Created incident INC-2026-0429: model-autoscaler-churn — https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0429

DeployBot: Canary rollback to v1-serve completed at 07:55 PST (deploy id: dpl_8921) :white_check_mark:

Alex: logs uploaded — https://redwood.internal/gists/abc123 (contains container logs + dmesg snippet).

Ron: agreed with Sam's plan. I'll apply the route override to reduce max_batch_size and monitor for 30m. Will report back at +15m and +30m.

Sam: if that doesn't hold, next step is to try pinning to a quant profile with lower mem footprint or increase node memory for the pool.

Maya: thanks. Handoff complete — please ping oncall channel if anything escalates. I'll be reachable on my phone for pager duty. :wave:
